text.text_excerpt: I love The Saint, only go after 1:30 AM. Total hole in the wall place. The drinks are good, although overpriced for a dive bar. I've met some of my best friends here. The outdoor patio is best after dancing inside, with great music. I stick to the dance floor and the patio. I will warn you ladies, be prepared for the college sleaze balls. The bathroom, of course, is the 4th layer of Dante's Inferno, but what did you expect?! Bring hand sanitizer. My only complaint is the bouncer(s) outside are INCREDIBLY rude. Also, be careful leaving, I always have my guy friend get his car and pick me up outside. DO NOT WALK ALONE!!! ...still great bar, fun, great variety of people, music, and cool plac...
